critical_findings.consequence: A policy cannot reliably condition on earlier public actions or on private facts it learned and retained after the transient choice payload disappears. Algorithmic comparisons can therefore measure memoryless snapshot policies rather than the intended imperfect-information game.
critical_findings.correction: Define a normative information-state/event contract before adding more named policies. Include actor-visible private knowledge, ordered public actions/chance observations, schema version, and a stable information-state fingerprint.
critical_findings.finding: The agent contract supplies only the current DecisionFrame snapshot. There is no canonical public event stream, observation history, or information-state representation with perfect recall.

critical_findings.consequence: After choosing leave, a future policy frame cannot know a fact the acting player should remember. This violates perfect recall unless the project explicitly declares a memoryless abstraction.
critical_findings.correction: Persist card knowledge with owner, target library, position/validity, and invalidation events; expose it only to the entitled player through information_state, not public observation.
critical_findings.finding: Jace +2 stores the seen top card only in pending_choice.data and deletes it after the leave/bottom decision; no persistent player-private known-top state remains.

critical_findings.consequence: An opponent may be unable to observe a public Force pitch card, and cannot canonically observe whether a Jace +2 choice moved the card to the bottom. This is information loss, not information leakage.
critical_findings.correction: Add public zone contents or public events for face-up exile, cast costs, revealed cards, and Jace choice result. Decide deliberately which Magic details are abstracted.
critical_findings.finding: Public zone identities and action outcomes are incompletely represented. public_dict exposes graveyard identities but only exile_count; Force pitch identity is removed into exile but omitted from the StackSpell params. The opponent receives no action history.

critical_findings.consequence: Tests can be internally consistent while the intended game, abstraction boundary, and information semantics remain undefined.
critical_findings.correction: Create one versioned CURRENT_SPEC.md and make tests cite normative rule IDs. Historical specs remain evidence, not authority.
critical_findings.finding: The only broad game spec is a historical document that still labels itself rev0002-incomplete and explicitly leaves Jace knowledge for a future version. No current normative spec supersedes it.

critical_findings.consequence: The machine-readable source of current strategic truth is stale even though many later guard artifacts exist.
critical_findings.correction: Replace revision-stamped claim registries with data/CURRENT_CLAIMS.json updated transactionally whenever evidence changes a status, scope, or next falsifier.
critical_findings.finding: The current claim registry is still rev0068. It calls claims C003 and C004 provisional using evidence that has since been superseded by rev0080-rev0089 population and candidate-firewall results.

critical_findings.consequence: It can catch implementation drift in supported transitions but cannot independently falsify a shared semantic misspecification.
critical_findings.correction: Keep the parity checker, but stop describing it as independent replication. Add an independently specified reduced game or OpenSpiel adapter for equilibrium/exploitability checks.
critical_findings.finding: The C++ shadow is a transition parity checker, not an independent game implementation. Python chooses policies, owns hidden-information semantics, applies the authoritative transition, then sends selected transitions to C++.

critical_findings.consequence: Current named agents are effectively stateless, but future perfect-recall/stateful agents would leak memory between games unless reset or recreated.
critical_findings.correction: Make lifecycle explicit: instantiate per seat per game or require reset(game_id, seat, seed) and test cross-game isolation before introducing stateful agents.
critical_findings.finding: Population C++ rollout helpers cache agent objects by name across games.

critical_findings.consequence: A carried-forward hash contract can be mistaken for physical re-verification or availability.
critical_findings.correction: rev0090 distinguishes historical verification from current physical availability. Next publish the immutable sidecar at a durable URI/PID and record per-revision verification mode.
critical_findings.finding: The inherited sidecar audit used a host-local absolute path, reported passed, and carried a stale note from rev0086. The linked core alone does not include a durable retrieval URI for the 72 cold records.

critical_findings.consequence: Verification is not read-only or hermetic; a validated tree can temporarily violate its own checksum contract.
critical_findings.correction: Write all ephemeral outputs to a temporary build directory outside the package and make audit_cube return a report unless --write-report is explicitly requested.
critical_findings.finding: Routine tests and cube audit create caches/build outputs and rewrite an audit JSON, changing the package until finalize_package.py is run.

critical_findings.consequence: The guard is useful evidence, not a proof that every historical row is behaviorally bound to all dependencies.
critical_findings.correction: Use mechanism/stratum sentinels plus a transitive run manifest containing code, models, configs, RNG streams, environment, and policy constructors.
critical_findings.finding: rev0089 exactly replayed 64 rows, but selection is evenly spaced by file order and all 1,632 inherited rows lack embedded policy identity digests. The runtime digest covers selected files, not a transitive environment/configuration closure.

executive_verdict: The cube is strongest as an adversarial scientific instrument that destroys false strategic stories. It is weaker as an imperfect-information game laboratory because its policy interface is a current snapshot, not a durable information state with public action history and perfect recall. Governance has outpaced strategic discovery.

heart.highest_value_capability: Claim autopsy: reproduce an attractive result, isolate the mechanism, construct a stronger opponent or control, and demote the claim when it fails.
heart.mission: Build a closed-world, reproducible imperfect-information laboratory that is better at destroying false strategic explanations than at producing impressive win rates.
heart.scientific_object: A five-card Magic-like microgame used to study closure, hidden information, resource endurance, policy populations, and falsification discipline.
heart.success_definition: A small number of current claims whose scopes, information assumptions, provenance, uncertainty, and falsifiers are explicit; strategic progress is measured by reduced uncertainty or exploitability rather than revision count.

recommended_sequence.action: Freeze new strategic promotion runs. Specify public events, private knowledge, information_state, agent lifecycle, and rule IDs; add regression tests for Jace known-top retention, Force pitch visibility, Jace bottom/leave observability, and cross-game memory isolation.
Create docs/CURRENT_SPEC.md and data/CURRENT_CLAIMS.json. Reclassify counter_guard and the rejected stabilizer using rev0080-rev0089 evidence. State a stopping rule and practical-equivalence region.
Build a reduced OpenSpiel-compatible game first. Report CFR/MCCFR convergence diagnostics and exploitability/best response; do not begin with the full microgame.
Replace the named-policy treadmill with an empirical payoff matrix, meta-solver, approximate best-response oracle, and PSRO or extensive-form double-oracle loop.

Split current invariant audit from historical museum audit; move six audit-pinned files cold; make validation read-only; add a transitive run manifest and RO-Crate-style provenance. Add CITATION.cff only after authorship and preferred citation are known.

corrections_applied: Added one canonical mission diagnosis instead of the usual repeated narrative quartet.
Added machine-readable mission/debt and structure inventory artifacts.
Corrected cold-sidecar audit semantics to distinguish carried-forward historical integrity from physical re-verification and availability.

speculation.hypothesis: The durable product is not a Magic bot. It is a reusable claim-autopsy framework: exact replay, adversarial controls, provenance, and mechanisms for demoting attractive but brittle findings.

The actual scientific domain has become resource closure and library management under hidden information, not generic control-versus-threat strategy. Naming that explicitly would make terminal variants and transfer tests more coherent.
Repairing information state may materially reorder Jace- and Force-heavy policies because current agents forget known top cards and miss public action details.

Governance has reached saturation: another guard can reduce procedural risk, but the next large knowledge gain is more likely from a better game contract and an oracle/equilibrium loop than from more revision-local audits.

A full exact solution may remain too large, but a carefully reduced game preserving Jace knowledge, Force pitch visibility, library-out, and closure could be tractable enough to expose exploitability and guide abstraction refinement.

stop_rules: No new named strategic policy is eligible for promotion until INFO-STATE-001, JACE-MEMORY-001, PUBLIC-EVENT-001, and SPEC-DRIFT-001 are resolved or explicitly declared intentional abstractions.
No doc-only revision should repeat refactor_audit, priority_reconsideration, or experiment_matrix templates; update the canonical current mission/claims/spec instead.
No claim may use passed to mean both operational validity and inferential support; report these gates separately.
No adaptive sampling result should use fixed-horizon intervals after optional stopping; preregister sample size or use time-uniform methods.
No cold-evidence audit should say passed without recording whether the bundle was physically present and rehashed in that revision.
